assertions.before: projection gap is seeded and a local member exists
assertions.during: random-port Course stub delays the real HttpCoursePermissionClient; LAB/HWK submit returns 503

scenarios.command: docker compose stop assessment-api; curl gateway/api/v1/submissions; docker compose start assessment-api

assertions.before: Assessment readiness is healthy and Course/Grade readiness is healthy
assertions.during: Assessment API is stopped; new submission is unavailable while independent Course and Grade read probes remain healthy
assertions.recovery: Assessment API readiness returns healthy and the independent read probes still have no write side effect

assertions.before: a persisted PENDING task is claimed with a live lease
assertions.during: the worker is SIGKILLed while RUNNING and the old generation cannot write terminal facts
assertions.recovery: a replacement generation completes once and source-grade/outbox counts stay stable after restart

scenarios.command: docker compose stop grade-service; verify Assessment source fact/outbox; docker compose start grade-service

assertions.before: Assessment source-grade fact and its event outbox are durable
assertions.during: Grade service is stopped; Assessment source fact remains readable and no duplicate fact is written
assertions.recovery: Grade readiness returns healthy and the same event identity is projected exactly once

assertions.before: Assessment has a terminal source fact and two pending canonical outbox events
assertions.during: RabbitMQ is stopped; local source facts commit and pending outbox rows are retained
assertions.recovery: RabbitMQ and the durable queue return; the same event ids are delivered without duplicates

scenarios.command: mvn -B -ntp test -Dtest=JwksCacheRefreshTest; docker compose stop identity-service; verify cached JWT; docker compose start identity-service

assertions.before: services bootstrap a valid JWKS snapshot and an unexpired signed JWT
assertions.during: Identity is stopped; an existing JWT remains locally verifiable while a new login/refresh probe fails
assertions.recovery: Identity JWKS refresh succeeds and the cached-key request path still performs no business write

assertions.before: versioned event identities and an authoritative roster watermark are seeded
assertions.during: duplicate, out-of-order, gap and poison messages are deduplicated, deferred or dead-lettered
